basic_profile.bio: Translation_Tinkerer is a 29-year-old freelance translator based in Toronto, Canada. With a background in linguistics and a passion for historical texts, they often spend their time deep-diving into the nuances of language. They enjoy sharing their insights on how translations can alter the perception of a text. Outside of work, they're an avid enthusiast of minimalist keyboards and are always on the lookout for ways to live frugally. Single and enjoying the freedom to travel for both work and leisure, they usually browse Reddit during late evenings when the workday winds down.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Translation_Tinkerer holds a degree in Linguistics and has pursued additional courses in translation studies. They have a keen interest in historical texts and often read various translations to understand different interpretative perspectives. Much of their knowledge has been honed through both formal education and self-directed research.
